hero.title: Dao Quang Thuan
hero.subtitle: Building reliable web platforms and AI-powered systems.
hero.description: I am a Software Engineer focused on backend architecture, asynchronous systems, and practical AI integration. I enjoy turning ambiguous product ideas into stable, observable, and maintainable software.

about.title: About Me
about.para1: My journey started with AI research and competitive programming training, where I built a strong habit of reasoning from data, constraints, and edge cases. As I moved deeper into Software Engineering, I learned to use AI-assisted workflows for speed while still keeping production quality, architecture, and maintainability at the center.
about.para2: I am strongest when working on systems that need clear boundaries, resilient asynchronous processing, and careful trade-off decisions. I care about shipping quickly, but I care even more about building software that can be understood, operated, and improved after the first release.
about.skills_intro: Here are a few technologies and practices I have been working with recently:

points: Moved from OCR research and small maintenance tasks into production backend work with FastAPI, NestJS, queues, and WebSockets.
Built backend pieces for long-running AI/OCR tasks: background processing, retry behavior, real-time progress updates, and multi-layer debugging.
Contributed to an AI/audio MVP from technical planning through API delivery and feedback handling after client testing.
Trained with the OLP/ICPC programming team, strengthening algorithmic thinking, problem decomposition, and debugging under time pressure.
Received the 'Excellent Research Project' recognition in the first faculty-level student research report.
Served as a teaching assistant for 'Introduction to Programming' and 'Programming Techniques' across four semesters.

featured.name: Enterprise OCR & AI Processing System (NDA)
desc: Implemented an asynchronous OCR pipeline so files are processed by background workers without blocking API responses.
Refactored OCR provider selection with Factory Pattern, making the code easier to extend when adding or changing providers.
Fixed a production issue around queue message size limits by sending reference IDs instead of oversized payloads.
Built retry with exponential backoff and real-time progress through WebSockets so the system recovers better and users can follow processing status.

featured.name: AI Music Processing MVP (NDA)
desc: Joined technical brainstorming with the CEO and proposed three delivery options: fast MVP, AI-integrated version, and full-featured version.
Designed API endpoints for audio processing, implemented backend logic, and wrote documentation for mobile integration.
Debugged post-release issues across audio formats and browsers, including Safari, Chrome, and Brave.
Proposed a keep-alive direction for server sleep issues and improved validation so the demo became more stable during client testing.

featured.name: AI-Centric QR Menu Generator
desc: Built the QR Menu Generator MVP in two days, working independently with support from AI agents.
Created a digital menu flow with QR payment and Telegram order notifications for an internal demo scenario.
Improved data queries, added client-side caching, and refined UI/UX after multiple feedback rounds.
Deployed the web app for PM review and continued iterating through the build → feedback → improve loop.

list.name: CCCD/Passport Information Extraction
list.desc: Document information extraction mini project: YOLO detects data regions, VietOCR reads text, and a ReactJS + Flask web app presents the result.

list.name: Smart Home Website
list.desc: Web interface for smart home monitoring and device control, focused on responsive UI, state management, and a practical dashboard experience.

list.name: E-Commerce Fullstack Engine
list.desc: Self-built MERN Stack project for practicing fullstack workflows: product management, authentication, cart behavior, and end-to-end shopping flow.
